title.narrative: ;UNICEF has made significant progress towards increased capacities to deliver inclusive, gender-responsive and quality education and skills development to children and young people in Libya. 30,011 vulnerable, out-of-school and non-Libyan children were reached through provision of non-formal education, life skills training, remedial learning and enrolment support, through improvements to the learning environment and provision of learning materials. UNICEF continued to lead the non-formal education sector including coordination of post-flood early recovery efforts in the East, and support for the Sudanese refugee response.;;;
